title: Front-controller routing: why /contact is not contact.php
lede: The contact page on a 12-year-old WordPress site shows a 500 error. The first instinct is to open contact.php in FTP. That file does not exist, and it never did.
hero_alt: Brass key on bone paper card with stamped ink label and clay-red wax seal, resting on scarred dark oak table.
